comment: Default-FAIL verification contract for T-007 (medium, acceptance-first). Required set = low ∪ {unit-tests, acceptance-tests, regression} per risk-gate-matrix.md; requirement-traceability is not required at medium and is therefore omitted from this contract's checks array (matching this feature's own T-001.contract.json and the epic-159-pillar-c precedent). BACKFILL, recorded as such: T-007's PASS gate (reports/quality-gate/20260809T024321Z-epic-190-a2-capability-registry-T-007.md, Run ID RUN-epic-190-a2-capability-registry-qg-T-007-seq0670, reserved identity-ledger sequence 670, attempt 1, review-context manifest reports/review-context/pending-epic-190-a2-capability-registry-sdd-evaluator-T-007-seq0670-manifest.json with 29 hash-verified inputs) predates this feature's contract/evidence-bundle closeout convention, so the Done flip recorded no pair; the seq0679/seq0680/seq0681 gates each recorded the resulting check-task-state debt as pre-existing and not attributable to their tasks. This pair is populated post-hoc on 2026-08-11 at HEAD c36a6cbb, following exactly the sanctioned T-006 closeout pattern (commit fc827c29): contract populated from the independent quality-gate evaluator's own verification results recorded verbatim in the seq0670 report, evidence bundle generated by plugins/sdd-quality-loop/scripts/generate-evidence-bundle.sh, both re-validated by check-contract and check-evidence-bundle at creation time. The seq0670 gate itself: VERDICT PASS, zero Critical, zero Major, six Minor (recorded, non-blocking); the evaluator independently re-ran both parity suite runtimes (bash tests/capability-registry-parity.tests.sh and pwsh tests/capability-registry-parity.tests.ps1 -> pass=22 fail=0 designed-red=0, exit 0 each), reproduced all four declared RED classes itself rather than taking the implementer's word, adjudicated the SDD_PARITY_INJECT fault-injection entry point by line-level inspection (it can add failures, never suppress one), confirmed both golden fixtures were produced by running the shipped scripts, confirmed suite registration in both runners after T-006's entry with the human-applied staged CI candidate carrying both steps, held three sibling suites at 21/0, 17/0 and 27/0 (regression), and recomputed all 18 originally-declared Outputs hashes (0 stale, 0 missing) before adding the two monotone human-copy path-alias rows recorded in the report's post-verdict section. Backfill-time re-execution at HEAD c36a6cbb, transcript at specs/epic-190-a2-capability-registry/verification/T-007/backfill-20260811-checks.log: both suites green again (sh 22/0/0 exit 0; ps1 22/0/0 exit 0), check-placeholders over both harness files passed, check-risk T-007 passed. Honesty notes: (1) the frozen tasks.md declares Required Workflow: acceptance-first for T-007 per the risk-classification policy's medium-tier row, and this contract records that declared value; the seq0670 report's contract-table header labels the workflow tdd — the discrepancy is recorded, not resolved, here, and is consequence-free because T-007's evidence meets the stricter bar anyway: genuine RED captures exist for both the wrapper-parity and runtime-parity halves (red-wrapper-*.log, red-runtime-*.log) alongside the GREEN logs, all committed and re-runnable. (2) The task-state-check row asserts the validity of T-007's own tasks.md row (Done with Approval, this very pair present), which every future check-task-state run re-verifies mechanically through this contract and bundle; at gate time the repo-wide tool exited 1 solely on the then-missing T-005/T-007 pairs — the debt this backfill clears — and with both pairs present check-task-state exits 0, measured at backfill time and recorded in the backfill commit.
